apps.localizedDescription: Match origami paper to jelly bean flavours. Measure sheets and beans from photos, get the best sheet for every flavour, and split look-alike beans into groups, entirely on device.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Beanbox uses the camera to photograph paper and beans so it can measure their colours. Photos stay on your device.
